description: The file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMigration' within a namespace related to the OrangeHRM system. It provides common methods for database schema management, data handling, language support, and configuration. It serves as a base class for specific migration implementations in the system's installer utility.

classes.name: AbstractMigration
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods for database schema management, data helpers, language helpers, and configuration helpers, to support migration processes in the OrangeHRM installer.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager object from the database connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the current database connection via a static method.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new QueryBuilder instance from the database connection.

methods.name: getSchemaHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of SchemaHelper, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getDataGroupHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of DataGroupHelper, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getLangHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of LanguageHelper, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getConfigHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of ConfigHelper, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Abstract method to define schema or data changes for migration.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Abstract method to return the migration version as a string.
